0x002C80.en: 「I'll show the power of the Water Masou Kishin.」

0x002E24.en: 「Highness! Tell me why!/ Or else I... I don't know what I'll do!」

0x002E83.en: 「Why... why, Highness!?/　I cannot fathom your heart...」

0x002EF4.en: 「Highness... what are you hiding?/　Tell me the true reason!」

0x002F59.en: 「Highness... I feel your inner pain.../　But I am the Gaddess's pilot!」

0x002FD0.en: 「...There's no path left/　for you to retreat, Highness.../　Then this is my only farewell to you!」

0x00306C.en: 「If only I.../　had seen your plight sooner.../　there might have been another way!」

0x0030F9.en: 「General Kirkus, power exists to be restrained!/　Wielding it recklessly is nothing but childish!」

0x00317C.en: 「What on earth/　changed you this much,/　General Kirkus!」

0x0031F1.en: 「I grant your skill, General Kirkus./　But I cannot turn a blind eye to usurpation!」

0x003271.en: 「As expected of General Ort.../　you've tuned the Browel to this level...」

0x0032E5.en: 「General Ort.../　if you'll fight beside the Highness.../　then I'll give my all as well!」

0x003366.en: 「I respect your loyalty,/ General Ort.../ but I am a Masou Kishin pilot!」

0x0033ED.en: 「Zamzeed is not a machine/　you're free to use/　as you please!」

0x00345F.en: 「In Shutedonias's hands, of all things.../　I'll take you back, Zamzeed!」

0x0034D9.en: 「Forcing Zamzeed/　to bend to your will... unforgivable!」

0x003532.en: 「These reflexes... he's no ordinary soldier./　I'd better be careful.」

0x003591.en: 「Surprisingly capable, this one.../　I can't let my guard down.」

0x0035E1.en: 「No opening in that stance... this one's dangerous.」

0x00361E.en: 「The usual Astral Shift armor.../　And anti-ectoplasm plating too./　Fighting you is just a waste.」

0x0036BD.en: 「I've no time for you, Louzorl!/　Get lost, now!」

0x00372E.en: 「Why not just run like you always do,/　Louzorl!」

0x00377E.en: 「Nice moves.../　Quite the veteran. I'd better be careful.」

0x0037DA.en: 「This one won't go down easy./　I have to stay sharp.」

0x00382D.en: 「What are you thinking, Ahmed!/　What you're doing is/　unforgivable for a Magus operator!」

0x0038CC.en: 「Langran's Magus operators fighting each other.../　Don't you see how wrong this is!?」

0x003949.en: 「Ahmed,/　I'm sure you have your own idea of justice.../　but I won't stand for it!」

0x0039D3.en: 「Ratel!/　There's no need to keep up this pointless fight!/　Surrender!」

0x003A45.en: 「...I have no choice./　If you insist on resisting,/　I'll use force!」

0x003AB7.en: 「Prince Terius has been taken from you,/　so there's no point in fighting!」

0x003B19.en: 「Ensign Lioness, wasn't it?/　There's no need to risk your life on this./　Please withdraw.」

0x003BA3.en: 「If you truly insist on fighting,/　I won't hold back, Ensign Lioness!」

0x003C0B.en: 「You.../　are you fighting for Ratel's sake?」

0x003C5E.en: 「You have no right/　to call yourselves Earth's guardians.」

0x003CA8.en: 「You've got the wrong enemy,/　all of you!」

0x003CF5.en: 「What good does it do/　to throw the surface world into chaos!」

0x003D3F.en: 「Water beats fire...this Gaddess will do it!」

0x003D9E.en: 「Melior Esse... I can't let my guard down.」

0x003DDB.en: 「"King of Ruin"... I won't show mercy!」

0x003E15.en: 「Hold on... I promise I'll save you!」

0x003E46.en: 「I won't let you trample our world!」

0x003EBD.en: 「So there are odd ones even among aliens...」

0x003F84.en: 「I can't believe immortality/　truly makes people happy...!」

0x00400E.en: 「There's no happiness to be found/　in giving up your humanity...!」

0x004061.en: 「Son Ganglong... this one won't be easy.」

0x00409B.en: 「Guang Long,/　I've no intention of sharing your values!」

0x0040EB.en: 「That monster daring to claim a god's name.../　The gall of it is beyond belief!」

0x004156.en: 「That's no god.../　more a giant of Jotunheim... horrifying.」

0x0041B8.en: 「Ruina.../　I can't just leave them be.」

0x004202.en: 「If you're going to spread/　fear and despair...!」

0x004280.en: 「To think such things existed.../　China's history runs deep.」

0x0042E2.en: 「To think I'd fight aliens/ in a Masou Kishin...!」

0x004372.en: 「Cute up close... no, I can't say that.」

0x0043AC.en: 「Yokijin... I need to take it down, fast!」

0x004408.en: 「Chokijin of the Four Fiends.../　If it harms people, I'll show no mercy!」

0x004464.en: 「That thing's supposed to be a god...!?」

0x004495.en: 「Gan Eden.../　you're no guardian god of Earth!」

0x0044EB.en: 「Euzeth, your fate won't change.../　It ends here for you!」

0x004553.en: 「Quite the grand ambition, Euzeth.../　but no future awaits you now!」

0x00460E.en: 「I won't let you have your way!」

0x004658.en: 「I can't just let you walk away!」

0x004780.en: 「N-not yet! I can't go down here!!」

0x00481C.en: 「Kyaah!? I-I'm being pushed back... this is bad.」

0x00485F.en: 「Augh!!/　This much power!? At this rate...」

0x0048A9.en: 「W-what the.../　to think it had this much power...」

0x0048F9.en: 「Nngh!/　Being pushed this hard... I didn't expect it.」

0x00494C.en: 「Please, Gaddess!!/　Hold on a little longer!!」

0x004A4E.en: 「Ngh... Your Highness.../　You really are serious, aren't you?」

0x004A98.en: 「M-magnificent, General Kirkus.../　to go this far...!」

0x004AF4.en: 「Augh!/ To think the Browel/ had this much power...」

0x004B60.en: 「W-with Zamzeed as my enemy, this is tough indeed...」

0x004BA6.en: 「I knew it was a foe not to take lightly,/　but to go this far...」

0x004C0B.en: 「No good.../　I can't take this one head-on...」

0x004C5E.en: 「I-I thought I hadn't let my guard down.../　but this is quite dangerous...」

0x004CC0.en: 「Ngh!! Ahmed.../　you've no intention of holding back...」

0x004D6C.en: 「Augh!?/　T-to think you'd go this far...」

0x004DF0.en: 「S-so this is the "King of Ruin's" power...!」

0x004E8C.en: 「Earth.../　I won't let you have your way with it...!」

0x004F2C.en: 「Ngh! Guang Long, I'm not done yet!」

0x004F5A.en: 「No matter what, I must stop that man.../　I have to stop Euzeth!」

0x004FF4.en: 「Ngh... so you mean to get in my way no matter what,/ Gaia Sabers...!」

0x00505C.en: 「I can't be beaten by the Ruina...!」

0x0050D6.en: 「A Yokijin's movements are/　a bit hard to read...!」

0x00531F.en: 「Gah, you really are good.../　but the match starts now!」

0x0053E4.en: 「Ngh... Your Highness.../　you truly won't back down...」

0x005434.en: 「Gah, you're every bit as good/　as one who's fought this far,/　General Kirkus.」

0x0054B5.en: 「S-so this is the Browel the General raised.../ no foe to take lightly.」

0x00552F.en: 「Ngh... it's Zamzeed all right.../　Even under enemy control, its power lives on.」

0x0055CE.en: 「Ngh, I've no time to waste/　on the likes of Louzorl!」

0x005658.en: 「Ngh, that's Ahmed for you!/　Your skills haven't dulled a bit.」

0x0056EF.en: 「Ngh,/　getting off this lightly is a stroke of luck.」

0x005826.en: 「Tch.../ But I won't go down to this!」

0x0058DB.en: 「You think that attack/　can down the Gaddess!」

0x00592B.en: 「Is that all?/　That's useless against the Gaddess!」

0x0059ED.en: 「Highness... are you hesitating?/　But there's no need to hold back!」

0x005A5B.en: 「Damage minimal. General Kirkus, you got cocky!」

0x005A9E.en: 「Custom or not, it's still a Browel!/ The power just isn't there!」

0x005B12.en: 「This much.../ You can't handle the Zamzeed!」

0x005B62.en: 「I see... just testing me, I suppose.」

0x005BD0.en: 「This much is no trouble for me.」

0x005C48.en: 「Ratel!/　If you're going to hold back, just quit fighting!」

0x005C8F.en: 「You mean to face the Gaddess with that?/　Ensign Lioness.」

0x005D2B.en: 「Even the Melior Esse/ are nothing much.」

0x005E5E.en: 「Oh? Less damage than I expected./　All show, perhaps.」

0x005EBA.en: 「I have to stop the Ruina here...!」

0x005F6E.en: 「Gan Eden.../　I can't let that light take me...!」

0x00602A.en: 「I'm confident in my reflexes, you know!」

0x0060EE.en: 「Ngh, as expected, Highness! But I dodged!」

0x0061E6.en: 「Fast! But if it doesn't hit, it's nothing!」

0x00624E.en: 「Ensign Lioness,/　facing the Gaddess with your skill is reckless.」

0x006349.en: 「Perfectio! Return to where you came from!」

0x0063CF.en: 「Kanan, I won't fall for your tricks!」

0x006406.en: 「A sage, but I can fight you evenly.」

0x006471.en: 「Euzeth, there's no way forward for you.」

0x0064CA.en: 「Erde... I won't let you consume me!」

0x006550.en: 「I won't let the Yokijin catch me!」

0x006587.en: 「Chokijin... just watch their moves and I'll be fine.」

0x0065E6.en: 「Oh? Were you aiming at me just now?」

0x006630.en: 「Eek?/　That was a little too close...」

0x00668D.en: 「Phew.../　Worlds better than before, General Kirkus./　But it has to hit first!」

0x00670E.en: 「Phew, nice skill. I can't let my guard down.」

0x0067AA.en: 「Phew, that was close./　A hit really would've done me in.」

0x0069A2.en: 「Leave the rest to me, Yang Long!」

0x006A95.en: 「Honestly... fine, then./ This is the last time, Saphine.」

0x006B63.en: 「Get back!/　The Gaddess can take this hit!」

0x006D30.en: 「Not yet! One more round, you're with me!」

0x006FEE.en: 「Think you can withstand this super hydro-pressure?」

0x00706F.en: 「A single drop becomes a river,/　the river becomes a torrent,/　the torrent becomes a flood...」

0x007153.en: 「Fangs of the wolf that devours worlds.../　Freki, Geri!」

0x0071E1.en: 「Children of Loki, shakers of the earth./　Cast off your chains and devour my foes!」
